claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two direct presentation helpers called by FACT-0075 Referee.CallFight are exact small bodies. MatchSEPlayer.PlayRefereeVoice (0x06005279) is an instance one-Int32-parameter method named vid with an exact 82-byte body. It calls MatchMain.GetInst(), and when isFastForwardMatch is nonzero it calls Fade.GetInst().IsFadeFinish(); only when that result is nonzero and unsigned MchFrameCnt % 20 is also nonzero does it return before dispatch. Otherwise it calls FACT-0065 RefereeMan.GetInst().GetRefereeObj(), tests the returned object through MemberRef 0x0A00002A op_Implicit, returns when that test is false, and on the true path calls Menu_SoundManager.Play_RefereeVoice(vid,1.0f). MatchUI.Show_Fight (0x060049F4) is an instance one-Boolean-parameter method named sw with an exact 13-byte body: it loads field gameObj_Fight (0x0400589B), forwards sw to UnityEngine.GameObject.SetActive, and returns. FACT-0075 pins the calls with raw arguments 0 and 1 respectively.
